question.prompt: Granny Smith has \(\$63.\) Elberta has \(\$2\) more than Anjou and Anjou has one-third as much as Granny Smith. How many dollars does Elberta have?

solutions.explanation:
Find Anjou's amount first because Elberta has \(2\) dollars more than Anjou. One-third of \(63\) dollars means dividing it into \(3\) equal shares, so Anjou has \(63\div3=21\) dollars. Therefore Elberta has
\[
63\div3+2=21+2=23
\]
dollars, choice E.
solutions.title: Find Anjou's amount first
